[[File:Electric Infliction icon.png|right]]
[[Electric Infliction]] is an [[Arts Infliction]] in [[Arknights: Endfield]].

== Overview ==
[[Electric Infliction]] is a debuff applied by Operators lasting for {{Color|20|1d}} seconds. If Electric Infliction is applied to a unit who already has Electric Infliction, then the debuff's duration is reset and the Electric Infliction gains a stack (up to a maximum of 4 stacks).

===Friendly===

Some [[Operators]] are capable of applying [[Electric Infliction]].
* If an Operator applies Electric Infliction to an enemy with Electric Infliction, then an [[Arts Burst|Electric Burst]] is triggered dealing {{Color|160% ATK|1d}} as {{Color|Electric DMG|6}}.
* If an Operator applies Electric Infliction to an enemy with a [[Arts Infliction|Non-Electric Arts Infliction]], then [[Electrification]] is triggered.

===Hostile===

There are no [[Enemies]] currently capable of applying [[Electric Infliction]].

==Changelog==
{{Changelog|
* <b>Beta Test II</b> {{Needs Verification}}
** {{G|Electric Infliction}} can now stack up to four times.
*** [[Arts Burst|Electric Burst]] changed.
**** <b>New:</b> When an Operator applies Electric Infliction to an enemy with Arts Infliction, add one more stack of Electric Infliction (up to 4 times) and trigger an Electric Burst.
**** <b>Old:</b> When an Operator applies Electric Infliction to an enemy with Electric Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} the Electric Inflictions and trigger an Electric Burst.
*** [[Electrification]] changed.
**** <b>New:</b> When an Operator applies Electric Infliction to an enemy with a non-Electric Arts Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} existing stacks of Electric Infliction to trigger [[Electrification]] with the latter determining the strength or {{G|Status Level}} of the reaction.
**** <b>Old:</b> When an Operator applies a Electric Infliction to an enemy with a non-Electric Arts Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} both Arts Inflictions and trigger Electrification.
* <b>Beta Test I</b> {{Needs Verification}}
** {{G|Electric Infliction}} added.
*** When an Operator applies Electric Infliction to an enemy with Electric Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} the Electric Inflictions and trigger an [[Arts Burst|Electric Burst]].
*** When an Operator applies Electric Infliction to an enemy with a non-Electric Arts Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} both Arts Inflictions and trigger [[Electrification]].
}}
